aboutHeading: Eco Craft Tiling Group in Truganina
aboutText: Based in Truganina, Eco Craft Tiling Group offers comprehensive tiling and waterproofing services for bathrooms, kitchens, and more. With expertise in wall and floor tiling, waterproofing, swimming pools, and renovations, we use sustainable materials to deliver quality results. From initial consultation through to expert installation, we manage every stage with professionalism and care.
servicesText: We provide a full range of tiling services in Truganina and surrounding areas. Our skilled team handles both residential and commercial projects, ensuring professional and timely completion.

services.title: Wall Tiling
services.desc: Expert installation of ceramic, porcelain, or natural stone tiles on walls for a durable and aesthetic finish.

services.title: Floor Tiling
services.desc: Professional floor tiling services tailored to your style, perfect for kitchens, bathrooms, and living areas.

services.title: Waterproofing
services.desc: Reliable waterproofing solutions to protect wet areas like bathrooms and laundry rooms from moisture damage.

services.title: Swimming Pool Tiling
services.desc: Specialised tiling for swimming pools using materials designed for water resistance and long-term beauty.

services.title: Bathroom Renovations
services.desc: Complete renovation services including tiling, waterproofing, and fixture installation to transform your space.

services.title: Sustainable Tiling
services.desc: We prioritise eco-friendly materials and methods in all projects for minimal environmental impact.
